premise: Bee comes up from Flower covered in yellow dust and Duckling kindly offers her a bubbly bath in the pond — but Flower explains the dust is what Bee carries from flower to flower so they can make seeds.
inspiration: The kind helper who helps the wrong way (folk), turned: nobody scolds, the idea was kind, and listening first is the help.
lesson: A kind idea is still kind, even when it isn't needed.
learning: Bees carry pollen from flower to flower, and that helps flowers make seeds.

en-US.title: Bee and the Yellow Dust
en-US.text: Out in the meadow, {flower:enter} Flower opened wide, and along came {bee:enter} Bee, buzzing. {bee:go on flower} {sfx:buzz} Down she landed… and up she came, {bee:face happy} yellow and dusty all over. {duckling:enter} {duckling:go to flower} Duckling came waddling by. {duckling:face surprised} [gasps] "Oh, Bee, you're so dusty! You need a bath!" {duckling:go to pond} Off he waddled to the pond. {canvas:bubbles 0.6} {duckling:go to pond by swim} {sfx:splash} Splish, splosh! In he paddled, and bubbles everywhere! {duckling:hop x2} "Come on in!" {flower:live shake-head} [gently] "Wait!" said Flower. "Don't wash it off. That yellow dust is from me. {bee:pulse} Bee carries it from flower to flower, mine to theirs and theirs to mine. That's how we make our seeds." {canvas:bubbles stop} {duckling:face sad} [sad] "Oh. My bath wasn't such a good idea." {duckling:live nap} He tucked his head under his wing. {flower:face happy} {flower:live talk} [warmly] "It was a kind idea," said Flower. Out popped Duckling with a happy {sfx:quack} quack. {bee:live hum} Bee hummed him a thank-you tune. {duckling:face happy} {duckling:live talk} [happily] "Busy day?" asked Duckling. "The busiest!" said Bee, and {bee:go to meadow} off she buzzed to the next flower.

es-ES.title: Abeja y el polvito amarillo
es-ES.text: En el prado, {flower:enter} Flor se abrió de par en par, y llegó {bee:enter} Abeja, zumbando. {bee:go on flower} {sfx:buzz} Se posó en ella… y al subir, {bee:face happy} iba toda rebozada de polvito amarillo. {duckling:enter} {duckling:go to flower} Patito pasaba por allí. {duckling:face surprised} [gasps] —¡Ay, Abeja, qué sucia vas! ¡Necesitas un baño! {duckling:go to pond} Y se fue contoneándose a la charca. {canvas:bubbles 0.6} {duckling:go to pond by swim} {sfx:splash} ¡Chof, chof! Se metió nadando, y burbujas por todas partes. {duckling:hop x2} —¡Venga, métete! {flower:live shake-head} [gently] —¡Espera! —dijo Flor—. No te lo quites. Ese polvito amarillo es mío. {bee:pulse} Abeja lo lleva de flor en flor: el mío a las otras, el de las otras a mí. Así hacemos nuestras semillas. {canvas:bubbles stop} {duckling:face sad} [sad] —Vaya… Lo del baño no era tan buena idea. {duckling:live nap} Y escondió la cabeza bajo el ala. {flower:face happy} {flower:live talk} [warmly] —Era una idea muy cariñosa —dijo Flor. Patito sacó la cabeza con un {sfx:quack} cua, cua muy contento. {bee:live hum} Abeja le tarareó una canción de gracias. {duckling:face happy} {duckling:live talk} [happily] —¿Mucho trabajo hoy? —preguntó Patito. —¡Muchísimo! —dijo Abeja, y {bee:go to meadow} se fue zumbando a la flor de al lado.
